name: Advanced Image Slider & Carousel
author: Raju Ahmed

sections.description:
Advanced Image Slider & Carousel helps you add a polished, mobile-friendly carousel to any WordPress page in minutes.

Whether you manage a business site, portfolio, landing page, or online store, you can showcase hero banners, product highlights, testimonials, or campaign visuals with clean controls and a modern Swiper-powered experience.

The plugin is built for everyday WordPress users and developers alike: use the simple shortcode workflow, or design slides visually with the Elementor widget when Elementor is installed.

Why choose Advanced Image Slider & Carousel?

  • Easy to use — create slides in the admin, then place them with one shortcode
  • Modern performance — powered by Swiper for smooth touch, loop, and autoplay behavior
  • Design control — change colors, overlay, buttons, arrows, and pagination without custom CSS
  • Elementor ready — optional widget with per-widget settings and custom slide content
  • Theme friendly — scoped styles that respect your theme instead of overriding the whole site
  • Compatible — tested with current WordPress releases and follows WordPress coding practices

Key features

  • Responsive carousel that looks great on desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Autoplay, infinite loop, transition speed, and multiple effects (slide, fade, cube, coverflow, flip)
  • Responsive slides-per-view controls for desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Navigation arrows and pagination (bullets, fraction, or progress bar)
  • Per-slide image, title, subtitle, description, and call-to-action button
  • Global Settings page for carousel behavior and a complete color system
  • Shortcode: [AWP-SLIDER]
  • Elementor widget: use CPT slides or build custom slides with a repeater
  • Keyboard navigation, grab cursor, pause on hover, and centered slides options

Perfect for

  • Homepage hero banners
  • Product or service showcases
  • Portfolio and photography galleries
  • Campaign and seasonal promotions
  • Feature highlights and announcement sections

Privacy and trust

Advanced Image Slider & Carousel does not collect personal data, does not phone home, and does not require an external account. Assets are loaded from your own WordPress site. Your slide content stays under your control.

Getting help

  1. Read the FAQ below for the most common setup questions.
  2. Make sure each slide has an image (featured image for CPT slides).
  3. Visit the plugin settings under AWP Sliders → Settings for carousel and color options.

If you find the plugin useful, please consider leaving a review. Feedback helps improve the plugin for everyone.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for Advanced Image Slider & Carousel.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP, install, and activate.

After activation

  1. Go to AWP Sliders → Add New.
  2. Add a title, description, featured image, optional subtitle, and button details.
  3. Publish your slides.
  4. Add the shortcode [AWP-SLIDER] to any page or post.
  5. Optional: open AWP Sliders → Settings to configure autoplay, effects, and colors.
  6. Optional: in Elementor, drag the AWP Slider widget and choose CPT or custom slides.
sections.faq:
Do I need coding skills?

No. Create slides from the WordPress admin and display them with the [AWP-SLIDER] shortcode. If you use Elementor, you can also manage everything visually inside the editor.

Does this plugin require Elementor?

No. Elementor is optional. The shortcode works with any standard WordPress theme. The Elementor widget is available only when Elementor is active.

How do I add the slider to a page?

Create at least one slide under AWP Sliders, then paste [AWP-SLIDER] into the page content. With Elementor, add the AWP Slider widget to your layout.

Why is my slide not showing?

Every slide needs an image. For CPT slides, set a Featured Image. For Elementor custom slides, upload an image in the slide repeater. Slides without images are skipped on purpose.

Can I change colors and styles?

Yes. Use AWP Sliders → Settings → Colors for global defaults. In Elementor, you can override colors, typography, button styles, and navigation for each widget instance.

Can I show more than one slide at a time?

Yes. In Settings (or Elementor carousel controls), set Slides per view for desktop, tablet, and mobile. You can also adjust spacing and centered slides.

Will it slow down my website?

The plugin loads Swiper and slider assets only when needed for pages that use the slider. Keep slide images optimized for best performance.

Is it compatible with the latest WordPress?

Yes. Advanced Image Slider & Carousel is tested up to WordPress 7.0 and requires PHP 7.4 or higher.

Where is my data stored?

Slide content is stored in your WordPress database as custom post type entries and plugin settings. Nothing is sent to third-party servers by this plugin.

How do I report a bug or request a feature?

Use the WordPress.org support forum for the plugin. Clear steps to reproduce, screenshots, and your WordPress/PHP versions help us respond faster.

1.1.0

  • Replaced the legacy engine with a modern Swiper carousel
  • Added a full Settings page for carousel behavior and colors
  • Added an Elementor widget with CPT or custom slide sources
  • Improved slide fields (subtitle, button text, button link)
  • Introduced a CSS variable color system for consistent theming
  • Improved admin usability and frontend reliability

1.0.1

  • Confirmed compatibility with WordPress 7.0
  • Security and stability improvements for meta saving and frontend output

1.0.0

  • Initial public release
